name: Hard's Marine

hero.title: Reliable, flexible marine transportation
hero.lead: From Channelview, Texas, Hard's Marine runs towboats and tugboats for shifting, bunkering, lightering and fresh potable water along the Gulf Coast. If it's marine related, we have the equipment and people to handle the job.

highlights.title: Over 40 years
highlights.text: We have served the Gulf Coast area since 1982.

highlights.title: Tugboats and crews
highlights.text: A fleet of capable tugboats and experienced crews at your disposal.

highlights.title: Safe and flexible
highlights.text: Marine transportation, in cooperation with our customers.

summary: Hard's Marine offers inland towing, bunkering and lightering from Channelview, Houston and the Gulf Coast area.

about.title: On the Gulf Coast since 1982, and still growing
text: Hard's Marine has served the Gulf Coast area since 1982, and we have continued to grow and evolve with the industry.
Our towboats are based centrally in Houston, and we work with barges and a wide range of experienced employees.
Our waterfront operations facility has 250 linear feet of bulkheaded dock space, a concrete driveway to the water's edge, a 5000-sq ft secure warehouse and an onsite operations center.
